newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX firms to 167.55 pts in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX firms to 167.55 pts in thin trading.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed mixed in thin trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Thursday, as the official SAX index firmed 1.78 points to close at 167.55.
Only 90 shares were matched on the bourse's listed floor and brokers said a lack of liquidity will continue to plague the market over the summer.
Oil refinery Slovnaft, the most-capitalised issue on BSE, closed up 65 crowns, at 900, but on a volume of only 12 shares. Steel maker VSZ lost 10 crowns, closing at 630, on 25 traded shares.
Overall, volume eased to 134,002 shares, from 246,030 shares traded on Wednesday, while turnover fell to 40.35 million crowns, from 52.44 million.
